描述_EN: the pronounced sheen on the satin enables the dragon roundels to stand out distinctly. the design has been matched across the seam and the side fastening. it is particularly soft and supple to the touch. this yellow robe is the kind of garment that was worn by wealthy chinese men.
描述_ZN: 缎子上明显的光泽使龙的圆环明显地突出来。 该设计在接缝处和侧边的扣子上都有匹配。 它的触感特别柔软，有弹性。 这件黄袍是中国富豪们穿的那种衣服。
